Modernes Büro in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterrasse und ÖPNV-Anschluss. Beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische. raw.title: Personalreferent (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (20 Stunden/Woche)
raw.description:
Als neues Teammitglied stehen Sie bei uns an erster Stelle. Freuen Sie sich auf ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine Aufgabe, in der Verlässlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Zusammenarbeit großgeschrieben werden. Werden Sie als Personalreferent (m/w/d) in Teilzeit am Standort Ratingen Teil der Lintorfer Eisengießerei GmbH und gestalten Sie unsere Personalarbeit praxisnah und zukunftsorientiert mit.

Aufgaben

In der Rolle als Personalreferent (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie insbesondere folgende Aufgaben:

  • Ganzheitliche Betreuung und Beratung der Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräfte in personalwirtschaftlichen, arbeitsrechtlichen und tariflichen Fragestellungen
  • Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung der operativen Personalprozesse vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt, einschließlich der Erstellung von Arbeitsverträgen, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen und Zeugnissen
  • Steuerung des Recruiting-Prozesses von der Stellenausschreibung über die Bewerberauswahl und Gesprächsführung bis zur Einstellung sowie Begleitung eines strukturierten Onboardings
  • Vorbereitung und Abstimmung aller entgeltabrechnungsrelevanten Personalveränderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der zentralen Entgeltabrechnung der DIHAG Gruppe
  • Pflege und Kontrolle von Personal-, Zeitwirtschafts- und Abwesenheitsdaten sowie Überwachung personalrelevanter Termine und Fristen
  • Begleitung von Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen, Qualifizierungen und betrieblichen Fortbildungskonzepten
  • Bearbeitung des betrieblichen Fehlzeitenmanagements einschließlich der Koordination und Durchführung des betrieblichen Eingliederungsmanagements
  • Vertrauensvolle und konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat sowie Vorbereitung der erforderlichen Beteiligungs- und Informationsverfahren
  • Erstellung von Personalstatistiken, Auswertungen und Kennzahlen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Personalplanung
  • Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung der HR-Prozesse sowie an standort- und gruppenübergreifenden Personalprojekten

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit personalwirtschaftlicher Zusatzqualifikation oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Arbeitsrecht oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer generalistisch ausgerichteten Personalfunktion mit, idealerweise in einem produzierenden Industrie- oder mittelständischen Unternehmen
  • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeits-, Betriebsverfassungs- und Sozialversicherungsrecht; Erfahrung im Umgang mit tariflichen Regelungen ist von Vorteil
  • Sie sind mit den operativen Personalprozessen entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles vertraut und haben idealerweise Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit einem Betriebsrat
  • Sie arbeiten sicher mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen; Kenntnisse in Varial World PW, SAP HCM oder einem vergleichbaren Personalmanagementsystem sind von Vorteil
  • Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzen Prioritäten sicher und behalten auch bei parallelen Themen und Fristen den Überblick
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und einen professionellen Umgang mit vertraulichen Personaldaten aus
  • Sie kommunizieren verbindlich und wertschätzend, überzeugen durch eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und arbeiten gerne pragmatisch und nah am betrieblichen Geschehen

Benefits

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Teilzeitposition mit 20 Stunden pro Woche und langfristiger Perspektive
  • Eine attraktive tarifliche Vergütung nach den Tarifverträgen der Metall- und Elektroindustrie Nordrhein-Westfalens
  • Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV)

Seit über 130 Jahren steht Ludwig Freytag für Qualität, Innovation und Verlässlichkeit. Mit rund 1.900 Mitarbeitenden realisieren wir überregional anspruchsvolle Projekte in allen zentralen Bereichen des Bauwesens - nachhaltig, wirtschaftlich und mit Blick auf die Zukunft.

Werde Teil unseres starken Teams und bring deine Stärken in eine Unternehmensgruppe ein, die Tradition mit Fortschritt verbindet.

Aufgaben

Netzwerk & Sicherheit: Du betreust unsere LAN-, WAN- und WLAN-Infrastruktur in zwei Rechenzentren und sorgst mit Sophos Firewalls und SD-WAN für Stabilität und Sicherheit. Außerdem planst du den Ausbau der Netzwerkinfrastruktur und koordinierst externe Dienstleister.

IT-Security & ISMS: Du wirkst aktiv an IT-Betriebsdokumentation und ISMS mit, koordinierst Security-Maßnahmen wie MFA, Phishing-Tests und Awareness-Aktionen und stärkst so die IT-Sicherheit im gesamten Unternehmen.

Server & Virtualisierung: Du betreust die Windows-Domäne (AD, DNS, DHCP), die virtualisierte Serverlandschaft (vxRail) sowie unsere Exchange-, Citrix- und SQL-Umgebungen. Zudem administrierst du Storage und Backups (DataDomain, Cloud).

IT-Support & Zusammenarbeit: Du übernimmst den 2nd-Level-Support für Kolleg:innen, arbeitest eng im IT-Team zusammen und steuerst den Support externer Partner, um einen reibungslosen IT-Betrieb sicherzustellen.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene IT-orientierte Berufs- oder Hochschulausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Administration von IT-Systemen, insbesondere Virtualisierungsumgebungen, Windows Servern und Netzwerken
  • Ausgeprägtes IT-Sicherheitsverständnis
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen zu unseren Standorten und Baustellen
  • Selbstständiges, dienstleistungsorientiertes Arbeiten im Team sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, sicheres Auftreten und Freude an der Arbeit im Team

Wertschätzendes Team & flache Hierarchien
Persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Geregelte Arbeitszeiten & gute Work-Life-Balance

Gut ausgebildete Kollegen

Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz

Fahrrad- & E-Bike-Leasing

Corporate Benefits

Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung

Attraktive Verdienstmöglichkeiten

  • Lead and mentor internal and external architects and technical teams across complex programs.

  • Practical, hands-on experience with Sparx Enterprise Architect, NAF v4 and/or ADMBw. 

  • Strong IT, software, or systems architecture background. 

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in solution architecture or technical IT consulting. 

  • Experience with TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL; relevant certifications preferred. 

  • Experience designing complex IT service-management platforms and processes. 

  • Experience with cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead internal and external architects and technical teams. 

  • Fluent German and English. 

Why TYTAN?

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry? We are Emma – The Sleep Company . Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. Ready to awaken your best with us?     We are seeking a talented and passionate Senior Backend Engineer to join our ERP team. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance APIs and distributed systems to support our ERP team. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and frontend developers to build reliable and scalable services that power our global operations. What you'll do: You will design, build, and scale backend services in Go and Typescript to support Emma’s global fulfillment and logistics operations, helping us become the world’s leading sleep brand.  You will develop and maintain robust, secure, and high-performance REST APIs that integrate with various internal systems and third-party providers. You will work with event-driven architectures using AWS services such as SNS, SQS, ensuring smooth communication across distributed systems. You will take ownership of backend components end-to-end—from development and testing to deployment and monitoring (full DevOps). You will ensure high code quality through automated testing, code reviews, and continuous delivery pipelines. You will be part of an agile, empowered team, actively sharing knowledge, mentoring team members, and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. You will contribute to recruiting efforts to help us grow our high-performing tech team. Who we're looking for: You have a strong track record of designing and delivering scalable and performant backend systems in a cloud environment, preferably with Go (Golang) & Typescript. You are experienced in building event-driven architectures using AWS SNS/SQS, and are familiar with modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). You have solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices, and systems integration patterns. You bring deep knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design patterns. You have several years of proven experience in backend software development, ideally in a fast-paced E-commerce or logistics-focused environment. You are familiar with CI/CD pipelines and take pride in writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. You are highly self-organized, with a strong sense of ownership and proactive problem-solving mindset. You are a team player with strong communication skills, and thrive in a collaborative, feedback-driven environment. Experience working with monitoring tools and implementing observability best practices is a plus. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience is required. What we offer: A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals.  A career development path tailored to your goals, with access to mentorship, training, and resources that will accelerate your professional growth.  The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects as part of a dedicated, international team.  A culture of collaboration and innovation, where you’ll have the freedom to implement new ideas, shape processes, and help build the DNA of a maturing company.  To work and learn from experts in diverse fields and get to know your team members at exciting company events.  Become an Emmie We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.   We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.   Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Warum diese Rolle?

GovRadar ist eine cloudbasierte Software zur automatisierten Erstellung öffentlicher Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Lösung sparen Behörden bis zu 90% Zeit in der Vergabevorbereitung, damit Investitionen schneller in die Umsetzung kommen.

Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.


Deine Mission

Als (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager bist du die treibende Kraft zur zielgerichteten Erweiterung unseres Teams und spielst damit eine entscheidende Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum. Du bist Teil des CEO Office und für Kandidaten, wie auch unsere Hiring Manager, die zentrale Ansprechperson im gesamten Recruiting Prozess.
Für diese Herausforderungen brauchen wir dich:

  • Verantwortung des end-to-end Recruiting-Prozesses, von Hiring Strategie über Stellenausschreibung und Pipeline Management bis zur Vertragsunterschrift
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Branding, um GovRadar zur ersten Wahl für Top-Talente im GovTech-Sektor zu etablieren
  • Active Sourcing und Aufbau qualifizierter Talent-Pipelines für verschiedene Rollen in Product & Engineering, GTM und Operations
  • Sicherstellung einer effizienten und wertschätzenden Experience für Kandidaten und Hiring Manager
  • Koordinierung von externen Stakeholdern, wie z.B. Headhunter für ausgewählte Positionen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von skalierbaren Prozessen mit dem richtigen Mix aus AI/Automatisierung und Human Touch


Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level
  • Umgang mit Tech- & Business-Profilen: du bist nachweislich in der Lage, Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichsten Backgrounds zu begeistern, zu qualifizieren und mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Spaß am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld: du hast bereits in einem Startup gearbeitet und siehst schnelle Veränderungen und fehlende Strukturen als spannende Herausforderung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, nimmst proaktiv Herausforderungen an und holst dir an den entsprechenden Stellen Unterstützung dazu
  • Daten- und Tech-Affinität: du steuerst deine Pipeline datengetrieben und suchst proaktiv nach Potentialen für Automatisierung/AI
  • Aufbau von Strukturen: du hast skalierbare Prozesse nicht nur angewendet, sondern bereits selbst von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung mitgestaltet
Nice to have’s
  • Talent Acquisition als neue Funktion von Grund auf aufgebaut & etabliert
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Teamtailor als ATS
  • Vernetzung im Münchner SaaS-Startup-Ökosystem
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem öffentlichen Sektor oder GovTech-Unternehmen


Was dich erwartet

  • Team & Kultur - ein hochmotiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Ownership - ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, eine neue Funktion nach deinen Ideen und Vorstellungen aufzubauen
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung - ein attraktives Fixgehalt zuzüglich performance-basierter Boni, die deine Erfolge belohnen
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen - Weiterentwicklung als Teil deiner individuellen Ziele, unterstützt durch dezidiertes Budget und monatliches Coaching mit deiner Führungskraft
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrides Modell (3 Tage im Büro direkt am Hauptbahnhof), flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit auf Workation
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit - du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Leadership Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact - trage aktiv dazu bei, den Staat in Deutschland handlungsfähiger zu machen und das Vertrauen der Menschen in die Demokratie zu stärken

  • Du übernimmst die kreative Federführung bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und präsentierst in Pitches
  • Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt im Designprozess ein und teilst deine Erfahrungen im Team

Must-haves

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikationsdesign, Interaction Design, Medieninformatik, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von Designsystemen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsverständnis und visuelles Stilgefühl
  • Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden, der Gestaltung komplexer digitaler Anwendungen sowie den Anforderungen an digitale Barrierefreiheit
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams in agilen Umfeldern sowie in der Moderation von Workshops und Präsentation von Designlösungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

  • Erfahrung in der Art Direktion
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Produkten, Designprozessen, Prototyping oder Code-Generierung.

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.

  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace und Cloud

  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung großer interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen

  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium 
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step. This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen. Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities. Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last. Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive. Nice to Have: Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality. Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar). Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption. Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data). Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments. Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS. Your Profile Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures. Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants. Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing. Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code. Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build. Proactive mindset with strong autonomy and initiative in a dynamic environment Fluent English is required, German is a plus. Why Us? An awesome team & great vibes Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed. Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title. Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role. Company pension program (bAV) Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution—investing in your financial future together. Corporate Benefits membership Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers. Complimentary food & beverages Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week. Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster mit einer KI-gestützten Software für die Entscheidungsgrundlage der Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bauträger, Banken und Investoren nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025.

Wir wachsen weiter – und um dieses Wachstum zu tragen, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als IT & Revenue Operations Manager (m/w/d), wahlweise in Berlin oder in NRW.

Du verantwortest unser IT-Management und unseren Revenue Stack. Auf der IT-Seite baust du die Systemlandschaft, mit der unser Team arbeitet – von Geräten und Zugängen bis zu nachweisbaren Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards gegenüber unseren Enterprise-Kunden und Investoren. Auf der Revenue-Seite verantwortest du unser CRM, automatisierst die Prozesse dahinter und schaffst die verlässliche Datenbasis, auf der Marketing, Sales und Customer Success ihre Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Zeit teilt sich zu gleichen Teilen: 50 % IT-Administration, 50 % Revenue Operations.

IT-Administration:

IT-Infrastruktur & Device Management

  • Du baust unser Apple-Setup von Grund auf neu auf – Enrollment, Blueprints und Konfigurationsprofile über Apple Business, sauber migriert und dauerhaft gepflegt
  • Du setzt einen verbindlichen Security-Baseline-Standard durch – Verschlüsselung, Update-Policies, kontrollierte Endgeräte – und hältst ihn nachweisbar
  • Du verantwortest den Hardware-Lifecycle end to end und planst den Gerätebedarf entlang unseres Hiring-Plans

Identity & Access

  • Du gestaltest, wie Zugriffe bei syte vergeben, geändert und wieder entzogen werden – gruppenbasiert, dokumentiert und ohne Lücken beim Offboarding
  • Du entwickelst Google Workspace als Identity Provider weiter und bringst SSO überall dorthin, wo die Plattform es hergibt
  • Du bringst Struktur in unsere SaaS-Landschaft: Lizenzen, Rollen, Berechtigungen – und die Tools, die bisher niemand freigegeben hat

Security & Compliance

  • Du machst uns gegenüber Enterprise-Kunden auskunftsfähig: Kontrollregister, Security-Fragebögen, Nachweise auf Knopfdruck
  • Du entscheidest unternehmerisch, welches Risiko wir bewusst akzeptieren und welches wir schließen
  • Du dokumentierst deine Prozesse in Runbooks, um eine Knowledge Base zu bauen

Revenue Operations:

CRM & Tech Stack

  • Du verantwortest unser HubSpot-Setup als zentrale Revenue-Plattform und entwickelst es weiter – Pipelines, Lifecycle Stages, Workflows und Reporting
  • Du sorgst für saubere Datenflüsse zwischen Sales, Marketing und Customer Success und bist unsere Source of Truth für Datenqualität
  • Du managest unsere Integrationen aktiv – HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator und unsere Produktdaten, verbunden über n8n

Prozessoptimierung & Automatisierung

  • Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe und automatisierst sie systematisch
  • Du baust Automatisierungen für Lead Routing, Scoring und die Übergaben entlang des Funnels
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein – für neue HubSpot-Features und innovative Ansätze in unserer Tool-Landschaft

Dein Profil

  • Hintergrund in B2B-Tech/SaaS: Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in IT-Administration, Internal IT, Systemadministration, RevOps oder Sales Operations mit – vorzugsweise in einem wachsendem Tech/SaaS Startup.
  • Du bist im Apple-Ökosystem zu Hause: macOS und iOS als Arbeitsplattform, Apple Business, MDM-Profile und das Terminal gehören zu deinem Alltag.
  • Plattform-Tiefe: Du beherrschst mindestens eine unserer Kernplattformen – Google Workspace oder HubSpot – und willst die zweite ebenso gründlich lernen.
  • Identity & Access: Du verstehst SSO, SCIM, OAuth-Scopes und Conditional Access als Konzept, nicht nur als Menüpunkt, und weißt, warum gruppenbasierte Zugriffe Einzelvergaben überlegen sind.
  • Automatisierung: Du kommst mit APIs und kleinen Skripten zurecht und erkennst, was sich automatisieren lässt – ob über n8n, HubSpot-Workflows oder ein paar Zeilen Code.
  • Daten & Reporting: Du hältst Datenbestände sauber und baust Dashboards, auf deren Zahlen sich Sales und Management verlassen können.
  • Pragmatismus: Du kannst begründen, welches Risiko wir bewusst tragen und welches wir schließen – und erklärst eine Einschränkung so, dass Kolleg*innen sie mittragen statt sie zu umgehen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst verstehen, wie ein B2B-Sales-Prozess funktioniert, und das System dahinter mitgestalten.
  • Deutsch- & Englischkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2).

Cherry on top

  • Apple-Zertifizierungen (ACSP, ACiT) oder ein vergleichbarer Nachweis deiner Plattform-Expertise
  • ISO 27001 Zertifizierung
  • HubSpot-Administration in einem B2B-SaaS-Umfeld

Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster oder Berlin (ca. 1-2 Tage pro Woche im Office)

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
    • BusinessBike: Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

title: IT System Engineer (m/w/d)
description: 📍 Berlin | Bezirk Lichtenberg | 2 Tage Home Office 💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung Du möchtest nicht nur IT-Systeme verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, wie moderne Technologien, Automatisierungen und digitale Prozesse in einem Unternehmen eingesetzt werden? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Unser Kunde ist dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin , welche mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz. Für die Weiterentwicklung der internen IT-Landschaft wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die Verantwortung für die Microsoft Umgebung übernimmt, Prozesse automatisiert und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen digitale Lösungen entwickelt. Deine Benefits Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr. Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen. Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg. Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro. Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander. Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung. Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. Deine Aufgaben Als IT System Engineer übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung einer modernen IT Umgebung und unterstützt dabei, Prozesse effizienter, sicherer und digitaler zu gestalten. Microsoft 365 & Azure: Administration, Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft 365 Umgebung mit Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune und Entra ID sowie der Azure Umgebung mit Host Pools, virtuellen Netzwerken und Speicherkonten. Systemverwaltung: Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Gruppen, Richtlinien und Sicherheitsrollen sowie Sicherstellung einer stabilen und sicheren IT Infrastruktur. Onboarding & Offboarding: Steuerung der technischen Prozesse rund um neue Mitarbeitende, inklusive Gerätebereitstellung, Berechtigungsmanagement und Automatisierung mit Power Automate. Netzwerk & Security: Überwachung, Wartung und Konfiguration der Netzwerk Infrastruktur sowie Administration der Sophos XGS Firewall inklusive Regelwerken, Remotezugängen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien. Automatisierung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Business Prozessautomatisierungen mit Tools wie Power Automate, Power Apps oder n8n von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Digitalisierung: Aufbau technischer Grundlagen für Automatisierungen, Schnittstellen und Konnektoren inklusive Governance, Berechtigungs und Freigabekonzepten. KI & Innovation: Einsatz moderner KI Tools wie ChatGPT oder Microsoft Copilot zur Optimierung interner Prozesse und Steigerung der Effizienz. Support & Projekte: Unterstützung im 2nd und 3rd Level Support, Leitung eigener IT Projekte sowie Weiterentwicklung von IT Standards, Dokumentationen und Sicherheitsprozessen. Wissensvermittlung: Unterstützung der Fachbereiche beim Einsatz von Automatisierungs und KI Tools durch Schulungen, Guidelines und fachliche Begleitung. Dein Profil als IT System Engineer Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich IT, Systemadministration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Systemadministration sowie Erfahrung im eigenständigen Betrieb einer gesamten IT Umgebung . Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 Technologien wie Intune, Entra ID, Teams, Exchange Online und SharePoint Online. Praktische Erfahrung von ca. 2-3 Jahren mit Microsoft Azure , insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Host Pools, virtuellen Netzwerken und Speicherkonten. Gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik wie LAN, WLAN, VLAN, DHCP und DNS sowie Erfahrung mit Sophos Firewalls , idealerweise der XGS Serie. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Prozessautomatisierungen mit Power Automate, Power Platform, n8n oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Kenntnisse in PowerShell Skripting, APIs und Webhooks. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit dem Anspruch, Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und erfolgreich umzusetzen. Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen zu analysieren und technische Lösungen verständlich zu vermitteln. Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu unterstützen und als technische Ansprechperson Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch. Du möchtest moderne IT Strukturen nicht nur betreiben, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln und digitale Prozesse nachhaltig verbessern? Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.</p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p>The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search &amp; Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p><strong>We value</strong> your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply state of the art ML on search using techniques in deep learning, bandits, transformers, LLMs, causal inference, and optimisations to make our users more delighted and engaged on the platform</li> <li>Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs</li> <li>Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications</li> <li>Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts</li> <li>Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation</li> <li>Help in recruiting new engineers. Should be able to convert ideas to code with ease</li> <li>Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals like classification, deep neural nets, and sequence-based models. Familiarity with modern NLP stack and multi-modal representation learning is a plus</li> <li>We’d love to see that you’ve worked with big data systems (Spark, S3, and Airflow) and can program (Java, Scala, or Python)</li> <li>Good understanding of system architecture. Have experience in big data technologies and streaming architecture, data pipelines, etc.</li> <li>Demonstrated AI/agentic-tooling fluency per the section above</li> <li>MS in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field, but a Ph.D. in CS or related fields is preferred</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ:&nbsp;</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;index=7&amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;index=8&amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=and&amp;index=9&amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;index=10&amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;index=11&amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based at our Oxford, England (UK) office, with the option to work a few days a week remotely.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Up to 5%<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1765</p> <p><strong>Role:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Staff Analog Mixed-Signal Design and Verification Engineer</strong> to join our <strong>Cryo-CMOS IC team</strong> at IonQ Oxford. In this role, you will design analog and mixed-signal blocks from specification through circuit design, simulation, layout, tape-out and silicon validation. You will also own top-level chip integration and modelling as a first-class part of our Cryo-CMOS development flow. In this you will build and maintain the model of the chip that the whole team simulates against, a mixed-abstraction model combining transistor-level circuits with Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS and SystemVerilog real-number behavioural blocks. You will decide which blocks are represented at which level of abstraction, keep the models faithful to the schematics and measured silicon. The full-chip model will then be used to verify the ASICs that control the quantum processor from room temperature down to a few kelvin.</p> <p>You'll play an important part in shaping the design, modelling and verification methodology, standards and sign-off criteria that support our work in building the world's most advanced quantum systems.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In this position, you will build and maintain the model of the chip that the whole team simulates against, a mixed-abstraction model combining transistor-level circuits with Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS and SystemVerilog real-number behavioural blocks. These models will be derived form first-principles mathematics and correlated against schematic and measured silicon. You will decide which blocks are represented at which level of abstraction, keep the models faithful to the schematics and measured silicon. The full-chip model will then be used to verify the ASICs that control the quantum processor from room temperature down to a few kelvin.</p> <p>You'll have the opportunity to set the design and modelling standards the programme signs off against, making trusted models to inform tape-out decisions, and raise the design and modelling capability of the engineers around you, contributing directly to the success of IonQ's quantum computing roadmap.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Own the full-chip modelling strategy: model architecture, abstraction levels, accuracy targets and sign-off criteria used across the IC development flow</li> <li>Owning analog and mixed-signal blocks (references, DACs, switches, regulators, clock distribution) from specification through schematic design</li> <li>Own top-level integration: define block interfaces and specifications, assemble the top level, and run the full-chip mixed-signal simulations that verify the ASIC Develop Verilog-A and Verilog-AMS models of analog blocks and assemble them into a simulatable full chip</li> <li>Build real-number models so the full chip runs in digital verification and regression at practical speed</li> <li>Derive models from mathematics: turn a transfer function, a Z-parameter network description or a MATLAB analysis into robust Verilog-A with well-behaved tolerances</li> <li>Define and run model-versus-schematic correlation, keeping models in sync with design releases, and feed measured silicon behaviour, back into the models and the block designs</li> <li>Stand up mixed-signal co-simulation and regression (Cadence AMS Designer, Xcelium with Spectre) Lead block-level design reviews and mentor engineers on circuit design and modelling craft</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>To be successful, you will need deep analog and mixed-signal design and modelling experience, typically 10+ years. You will have designed blocks proven in silicon and models and used in production tape-out flows. You will bring expert transistor-level design of precision analog blocks (references, DACs, regulators, switches, clock distribution) taken through PVT and Monte Carlo, layout and silicon validation, together with expert Verilog-A and Verilog-AMS and strong real-number modelling.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Multiple tape-outs with responsibility for block design and top-level integration, including silicon bring-up and bench characterisation</li> <li>Strong mathematical foundations: linear systems, Laplace and z-domain analysis, network (Z-) parameters, noise and non-linearity</li> <li>Fluency in a production Cadence flow: Virtuoso, Spectre, Xcelium and AMS Designer or similar co-simulation environments, including parasitic extraction and post-layout sign-off</li> <li>SystemVerilog, plus MATLAB or Python/NumPy for analysis and model validation; scripting to automate model generation, checking and regression</li> <li>Cryogenic, space or other extreme-environment silicon experience will be highly beneficial, especially designing beyond foundry model validity using measured device data</li> </ul> <p>We're looking for someone who can design a block to specification and model it at the right fidelity, derive a model from equations and implement it end to end. You should be able to judge what to model and at what abstraction, align designers, verification and systems engineers on what a model does and does not promise, and contribute effectively within a fast-moving, highly technical team.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We want to make the world a better place and change people's lives through Monzo.</p> <p><strong>About our Financial Crime Data Team:</strong></p> <p>As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a<strong>&nbsp;Data Science Manager</strong> to lead one of our key product areas for Financial Crime.</p> <p>As a Data science manager, you’ll be working in an ever changing environment work in collaboration with Product, Risk and Engineering peers and champion the data strategy and lead a cross-functional team.</p> <p>You’ll help us build and improve these for now and for our future roadmap. We’re looking for a leader with hands-on experience, data driven strategic leader who can bring fresh thinking and new ways to inspire the team and our customers</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>You’ll work closely with the Product Managers, engineers, and Financial Crime control owners in an agile product environment. Your work will focus on improving our efforts in financial crime detection, prevention and mitigation, ensuring we stay ahead of emerging threats and regulatory requirements.</p> <p>You’ll help your team grow, hiring new team members, supporting their personal development. You will manage a team with Data Scientists and Data Analysts, working together with Analytics Engineers to drive product innovation and you’ll get to see the impact of all your work in the product changes we make.</p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data folk the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a key leader in building a discipline of exceptional data scientists and analysts working on making Monzo world class at detecting and fighting financial crime activity</li> <li>Help hire, develop and retain talented Data people</li> <li>Generate insights that can change the direction of our financial crime strategy</li> <li>Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development and build a strategic understanding of the business while structuring complex projects to bring them to life</li> <li>Liaise with risk, product and engineering managers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You <strong>must</strong> have at least 4 years of experience as a Data Science Manager- at least 2 of them managing a data team larger than 4 people</li> <li>You are a strong strategic data leader and love to drive decisions</li> <li>Strong experience with working with executive or C-level peers, managing stakeholders across levels of seniorities and disciplines</li> <li>You know what it takes to manage top tier Data talent</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to work autonomously to impact the future of a fast growing, ever evolving business</li> <li>You're familiar with using a variety of Data Science tools (from business intelligence, experimentation and causal inference through to machine learning), and coding languages (Python and SQL). You know when to pick the right tool, and can help others do the same</li> <li>Experience in financial crime, fraud detection, or similar areas (Trust &amp; Safety, Integrity, Security) is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ul> <li>30 minute recruiter call&nbsp;</li> <li>45 minute call with hiring manager&nbsp;</li> <li>3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on ----- <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK&nbsp;</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p><strong>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> here</a></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-NB2 #LI-Remote</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out. You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend. You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops. You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week. What you’ll work on Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further. Now Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business. Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure. Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel. Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics. Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team. Next Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating. Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly. Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users. Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area. Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it. Later Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting. Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work. Support company secretarial administration. About you We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most. Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability. Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go. Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it. Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership. End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes. Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on. Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch. Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage. raw.title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Time off

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.
