raw.title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
raw.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Conduct security review on emerging Docker products

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

  • Actively participate in architecture design reviews with the team

  • Contribute to a Security-owned project or initiative

  • Collaborate with Docker developers to validate and resolve discovered vulnerabilities

  • Enhance incident response capabilities by participating in on-call rotation and post-incident activities

  • Create and maintain security documentation and runbooks

First Year Outlook

  • Contribute to the security roadmap for improving security controls

  • Strengthen Zero Trust architecture and least privilege access controls

  • Enhance security monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Perform security reviews for major product releases

  • Own and run recurring penetration tests and adversary-emulation exercises across Docker products, and engage with external researchers

  • Support audits and ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27xxx

  • Advocate for “security by design” in all product features

  • Become well versed in Docker products and emerging AI technologies

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

EU: €118,860 – €169,800+ equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

#LI-REMOTE

HubSpot an advantage</li> <li>A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work</li> <li>Must be based in the US, UK, Germany.</li> <li>Ability to travel when and where required</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE</strong></p> <p><strong>By 3 Months… </strong>You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process, and on how the handoff to strategy and account management works. Fluent in MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, with the credibility to coach both new and experienced SEs on applying them. Clear, inclusive communicator who can flex from deep technical detail to executive-level value narratives, and can teach others to do the same. Collaborative leadership style, comfortable partnering with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Product Marketing leadership as peers, not just stakeholders. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks.</p> <p>You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures. You will play a key part in shaping the architecture in a genuinely exciting and fast-paced domain.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, low-cost storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. 

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system.

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems fundamentals, even without core execution-engine experience specifically.

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or general lakehouse/data-lake architectures.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

title: Marketing Lead
description: Who We Are: At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love. Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work. And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale. 🔑 About The Job Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen. Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth. This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time. You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution. 🔧 What You’ll Be Doing Build the go-to-market strategy Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale. Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation. Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set. Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time. Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition. Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth. Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs. Lead every campaign Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch. Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief. Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives. Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time. Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market. Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy. Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation. Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact. Build the playbook Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently. Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate. Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys. Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data. Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type. Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time. Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap. 🤩 About You We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions. You'll probably have: Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles. Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth. Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data. A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth. Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies. Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals.. The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines. Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists. Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist. The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done. 🙌 What’s In It For You Generous stock options scheme 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays Private medical and dental insurance 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2% A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships Enhanced family leave policies Life assurance of 4x your salary DEI Statement We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times. We are scaling a high-impact Strategy & Operations team within the CEO Office to strengthen product delivery and execution across the business.

As a Manager, Strategy & Operations, you will be a hands-on operator embedded in a designated Product team or pillar. Working alongside Product, Engineering and other functions, you will lead complex strategic and operational initiatives, align stakeholders, manage dependencies, resolve blockers and drive delivery from planning through launch. raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Design Engineers (product focussed, with Frontend-leaning/UX) to develop and maintain the Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features. You will also help to mentor our less experienced Frontend-leaning engineers on the team.

 Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

  • Building the standard for AI interfaces, this includes UX/UI workflows and development roadmap on Creative Platform, Image Generation, and GenAI.

  • High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end-to-end features across the full stack of Creative products, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.

  • Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:  

  • Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Collaborate with Design, Engineering and Growth to ensure cohesive end-to-end web experiences.

  • Execute and iterate on designs based on user feedback, and best practices.

  • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

We do require:

  • Frontend Engineer experience with an eye for design, and are proficient in Next.js, React, and likely design libraries like Shadcn, Framer Motion or D3.

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • You have a portfolio showcasing web projects and your ability to craft compelling web experiences, with a strong preference on personal branding.

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Bonus: experience building media or creative products serving enterprise customers

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Dispenser
description: About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS Bolt Pharmacy is our main UK pharmacy brand and part of AIOS, the company building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. This role is based at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn. AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor. We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy We are building a world-class team. As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace. You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it. You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving. Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team. Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence. This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns. You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski . You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support. Key responsibilities Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists. Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance. Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately. Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed. Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements. Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates. Need to have Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification. Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety. Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation. Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist. Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance. Nice to have Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser. Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely. Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly. Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied. Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism. Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." Compensation & Benefits Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build. Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off. Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role. Benefits The stuff below is cool as well. Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills. Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing. GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable. Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy. Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm. What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.   Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.   As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting , enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption. Key Responsibilities Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap , defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market. Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release , focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on. Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction. Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience , ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain. Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted. Own positioning and competitive strategy , monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation. Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption. Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption. Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing , creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes. Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact. Skills and Responsibilities 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience , ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment. Proven track record of owning products end-to-end , from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption. Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements , working closely with Product and Engineering teams. Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape , including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability. Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments , with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products. Strong commercial and go-to-market experience , including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing. Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, vessel identity, geospatial analysis, ownership, and flows . Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, regulatory, and NGO audiences . Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior external stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action , with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection. Nice to have Direct experience within the fisheries or seafood sector , particularly procurement, traceability, or certification. Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product. An established network across seafood buyers, certification bodies, regulators, or fisheries NGOs . Understanding of relevant fisheries regulations, including IUU regulations, US SIMP, or the EU carding system . We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?   We make things happen We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.   We build together We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.   We are here to help We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.     Our People Pledge   Don’t meet every single requirement? Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.   Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to <strong>the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.</p> <p>You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own</strong> the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four</li> <li><strong>Define</strong> what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard</li> <li><strong>Partner</strong> with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities</li> <li><strong>Own</strong> record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity</li> <li><strong>Ship</strong> the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature</li> <li><strong>Lead</strong> the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>You'll be a great fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long</li> <li>You have worked at millions-of-records scale</li> <li>You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams</li> <li>You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design</li> <li>You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer.&nbsp;</li> <li>You are fluent in English<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>It would be fantastic if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it</li> <li>You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it</li> <li>You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children</li> <li>25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT</li> <li>Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care</li> <li>Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy</li> <li>Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib</li> <li>A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class</li> <li>50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription</li> <li>ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib</li> <li>For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support</li> <li>Relocation support in case of international mobility</li> <li>Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our interview process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti)&nbsp;</li> <li>Case Study with Product Panel</li> <li>Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team</li> <li>At least one reference check</li> </ul> <p>We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our<a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/getting-hired/"> candidate experience page</a>.</p> <h2><strong>Job details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Permanent position</li> <li>Full-time</li> <li>Levallois-Perret, France</li> <li>Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)</li> <li>Start date: as soon as possible</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We welcome everyone</strong></h2> <p>At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.</p> <p>The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.</p> <p>To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.</p> <p>Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!</p> <h2><strong>Your data privacy</strong></h2> <p><em>All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. Engagement & Event Manager – Healthcare (all genders) - France (Paris)

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will be responsible for building and developing a strong and consistent experience for our healthcare professional network, particularly through congresses, events, training and other engagement opportunities.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify opportunities and needs from the field and build an event strategy that maximizes the quality and impact of these interactions.

  • Define and lead the B2B acquisition and event experience strategy by identifying congresses, events, trainings, webinars and other opportunities to engage with healthcare professionals, and building an annual calendar aligned with the company’s objectives

  • Lead the organization and preparation of congresses and events, coordinating internal and external stakeholders to create a professional and consistent experience for participants

  • Develop experience and engagement formats tailored to healthcare professionals, including trainings, workshops, webinars, breakfasts and regional events, based on needs identified in the field

  • Maximize acquisition and conversion by working with Regional Managers to identify network activation needs, turning common needs into scalable initiatives and ensuring continuity between events, activation and follow-up

  • Build a differentiated healthcare professional experience by designing the professional journey before, during and after each event to strengthen engagement with Sunday Natural

  • Measure and optimize performance by analyzing attendance, lead quality, conversion, engagement and ROI to identify the highest-performing events and continuously improve our event strategy

Your profile

  • You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing, event or project management

  • You have a strong ability to understand and communicate scientific topics in an accessible way and feel comfortable discussing scientific subjects with different stakeholders

  • You are organized, autonomous and have strong project management and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple events and stakeholders simultaneously

  • You have a business-oriented mindset and are able to assess the relevance of opportunities, prioritize investments and measure their impact

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Product teams and are able to turn field needs into relevant and scalable experiences

  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Juriste Senior - Dpo & Conformite Ia (H/F/Nb)
description: Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques. Notre ligne éditoriale se démarque grâce à des concepts innovants, des gameplays alternatifs et des univers originaux qui transcendent les frontières du jeu vidéo. Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous . Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un·e Juriste Senior - DPO & Conformité IA. Vos missions : Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe. À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes : 1) Gouvernance & Suivi de la Conformité Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe. Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche). Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP. Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.). Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe. 2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DSI/RSSI) sur la sécurisation des données pour assurer la gestion des incidents de sécurité (incluant la préparation des notifications aux autorités) dans les délais impartis. Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis. Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design). 3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act) Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design). Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables. 4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.). Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires. Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe. Ce que l’on attend de vous : Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master 2 en droit du numérique, droit des nouvelles technologies, protection des données et/ou spécialisation DPO et disposez d’une expérience confirmée de 7 ans minimum en protection des données (une expérience en tant que DPO ou DPO adjoint est fortement appréciée). L'obtention d'une certification reconnue (type IAPP : CIPP/E, CIPM) constitue un véritable atout. Vous disposez d’une excellente maîtrise opérationnelle du RGPD et des réglementations liées à la protection des données, et d’une connaissance pratique des réglementations internationales (CCPA/CPRA, UK GDPR, PIPEDA, etc.). Vous maîtrisez des enjeux liés au traitement des données des mineurs et aux mécanismes de vérification d'âge. Vous faites preuve de solides connaissances de la réglementation relative à l’encadrement de l’IA (AI Act / RIA) et des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'IA. Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral (rédaction et négociation autonome de contrats). Vous disposez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles. Ce que l’on dit de vous : Vous faites montre d’une approche par les risques affirmée, pragmatique et orientée business (capacité à hiérarchiser les enjeux et à formuler des réponses opérationnelles proportionnées). Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et démontrez une forte autonomie dans la gestion des dossiers. raw.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Mission Principale :
 
En tant qu'Account Executive SMB, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing.
 
Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients.
 
 
Responsabilités :
 
1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral :
- Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes).
- Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée.
- Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects.
- Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature.
 
2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales :
- Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects.
- Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes
- Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline
 
3. Collaboration interservices :
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client.
- Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux.
 
4. Développement de la connaissance marché :
- Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB.
- Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché.
 
Objectifs et KPIs :
- Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants.
- Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées.
- Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle.
- Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels.

Compétences requises :
  • Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B.
  • Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing).
  • Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités.
  • Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.

    • Qualités personnelles :
  • Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance.
  • Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence.
  • Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

raw.title: Director, Pharmacometrics
raw.description:
Step into a role where science meets strategy and your expertise shapes the future of drug development. As a Director, Pharmacometrician, you’ll lead high-impact modeling and simulation efforts within a dynamic Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) environment. You’ll guide teams, mentor pharmacometricians, and provide strategic insight to clients at key development milestones. This role also offers the opportunity to represent clients in interactions with regulatory agencies. If you thrive on collaboration and solving complex scientific challenges, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact.

About the role

This role combines scientific leadership and strategic impact, leading population PK analyses while developing innovative approaches to improve efficiency and accuracy. You will design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies, provide strategic guidance to clients, and contribute to regulatory documents and agency interactions. In addition, you’ll foster client relationships, support business development, and stay at the forefront of PK/PD advancements to drive continuous improvement.

Your main responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Lead and conduct population PK analyses using advanced modeling tools and methodologies
  • Develop and implement innovative approaches to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of PK analysis
  • Design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies (renal, hepatic, TQT, ADME, DDI, BE/BA, SAD, MAD, etc.) and provide guidance to optimize pharmacokinetic sampling and dosing strategies  
  • Provide strategic guidance to clients, owning deliverables and developing clinical pharmacology plans
  • Author and review PK reports and clinical pharmacology sections of regulatory documents
  • Represent clients in regulatory interactions and contribute to business development and relationship management

Requirements

About You

If you are a driven clinical pharmacology professional with 6–10 years of experience in drug development and pharmacometrics and you bring sharp analytical thinking and expertise in tools like NONMEM, Pirana, and R to deliver high-impact insights while being client-focused and a natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, combining strategic thinking, strong communication, and business acumen to build relationships and drive results, this role is for you.

To be successful we are looking for the following traits and behaviors:

  • Life science, healthcare and/or business degree 
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant work experience, including experience in drug development, clinical pharmacology, and pharmacometrics 
  • Regulatory experience including regulatory report writing essential. Experience with regulatory submissions including INDs, CTAs, regulatory meetings and NDA/BLA/MAA submissions
  • Proficiency in NONMEM, Pirana, and R software preferred 
  • Excellent organizational, negotiating and financial skills 

Benefits

About Allucent

Our mission is to help bring new therapies to light. When you work at Allucent, that means rolling up your sleeves and applying your unique skill set, expertise, and knowledge to build partnerships with our clients in their pursuit to develop new, life-improving treatments.

 

If you're passionate about helping customers develop new pharmaceuticals and biologics; have an entrepreneurial spirit; and ready to join other science, business, and operations leaders, we would love to get to learn more about how we can help each other grow.

 

Together we SHINE. Find more information about our values.

 

Benefits of working at Allucent include:

  • Comprehensive benefits package per location
  • Competitive salaries per location

  • Eligibility for our Spot Bonus Award Program in recognition of going above and beyond on projects
  • Eligibility for our Loyalty Award Program in recognition of loyalty and commitment of longstanding employees

 

Apply now!

title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten. Deine Rolle bei June Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. So arbeiten wir Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu. Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten. Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten. Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.
